Source contracts: scripts/check_product_identity.py

scripts/check_product_identity.py

Python · Tier B

Reject retired product names in source paths, contents, and distribution archives.

Usage

python scripts/check_product_identity.py [PATH ...]; default is tracked/new repo files.

Inputs

Optional files/directories; pinned upstream schema digests identify unrelated protocols.

Side effects

Reads files and prints findings; never modifies source or unpackages onto disk.

Cleanup

Archive readers close within each check; no processes or temporary files remain.

@see docs/engineering/configuration-catalog.md

Significant symbols

Symbol Line Documentation
inspect_blob 39 Inspect archive members recursively; allow only byte-identical upstream snapshots.
candidates 74 Use Git's source inventory by default, excluding local installations and build caches.
main 92 Return a failing status for any retired name outside the reviewed exceptions.
